plainTranslation:
This person helps you see more than you can see on your own.

They help you see more possibility in what you are thinking about. An idea, question, or decision often feels clearer and more expansive after you talk to them.

The gift of this connection is perspective. This person reminds you not to limit yourself too quickly. They encourage possibility, but they do it in a way that helps you think more deeply, not just more positively.

The challenge is that this connection asks for participation. Its gifts tend to appear in the exchange itself. If you keep your thoughts tucked away until they are fully formed, you may never discover what this person could have helped you uncover.

Let them into the process before you have all the answers. Share the unfinished version. Sometimes their perspective reveals a path you could not have found alone.
